app.name: WiiFin-XE
app.short_description: Jellyfin client for Nintendo Wii (XE edition)
app.long_description: WiiFin-XE is an enhanced Jellyfin media client for the Nintendo Wii. Features Netflix-style home rows, full GameCube and Classic controller navigation with on-screen transport overlay, configurable playback controls (C-Stick scrubbing & D-Pad volume), live volume HUD, custom theme engine and in-app editor, clock screensaver, configurable subtitle defaults, and direct play support.
